msDesc.head: Register of the hospital of St. Mary, Great Yarmouth

msItem.title: Charter of refoundation of the hospital by the bailiffs and burgesses of Great Yarmouth, 2 May 1386, with confirmations by Henry Despenser, bishop of Norwich, and the prior and chapter of Norwich, 8 May 1386.

Agreement between the prior and chapter of Norwich Cathedral, the bailiffs and burgesses of Yarmouth, and the warden and residents of the hospital, 5 November 1386, with confirmation by Henry Despenser, 20 December 1386..

Letters patent of Richard II granting licence in mortmain to William Oxeney and Robert Howelyn, burgesses of Yarmouth, to grant lands and rents in Yarmouth to the bailiffs and commonalty to support the hospital of St Mary, 22 September 1392.
Grant by William Oxeney and Robert Howelyn, burgesses of Yarmouth, of the same lands and rents in Yarmouth to the bailiffs and commonalty to support the hospital of St Mary, 1 September 1397.

Grant by William Oxeney and Robert Howelyn, burgesses of Yarmouth, of the same lands and rents in Yarmouth (given in detail) to the bailiffs and commonalty to support the hospital of St MaryAgreement between the prior and chapter of Norwich Cathedral, the bailiffs and burgesses of Yarmouth, and the warden and residents of the hospital, 1 September 1397.
Rental of the hospital, 23 April 1398, with added names of later tenants, 15th and 16th century.
List of rents given by William Gerbrigge
Charter of William and John Gerbrigge to the hospital, 1304
Indenture for the support of an almshouse, 1392
Notes of additional rents added on an originally blank leaf, 16th century

msItem.rubric: Þese arn the constitucionys & ordinaunces mad & ordined to be kept in þe hospitall of seynt mary of gret ȝermuth
msItem.note: An English version of the ordinances in the charter of refoundation (fol. 1r-4r); a separate codicological unit, see Collation. Fol. 28r is blank.
An English translation of most of the material on fols. 1r-26v produced by Henry Manship, notary public and burgess of Great Yarmouth, in 1614. Fols. 73rv and 74rv are blank.

listBibl.bibl: Manship's translation, together with the texts not translated by him, is edited in ‘Cartulary of St. Mary's Hospital, Great Yarmouth’, ed. Carole Rawcliffe, in Poverty and Wealth: Sheep, Taxation and Charity in Late Medieval Norfolk, Norfolk Record Society 71 (2007)

supportDesc.collation: Fols. 1-31: medieval endleaf, pasted down; 1(8)-2(8), 3(8-1, last cancelled?) (fols. 1-23), 4(6-2, fourth and sixth leaves cancelled after fols. 26 and 27) (fols. 24-27) | 5(6-2) (fifth and sixth leaves cancelled). One catchword on fol. 8v.

layoutDesc.layout: Fols. 1r-27v: c. 32-35 long lines, ruled in leadpoint, ruled space c. 195 c. 135
Fols. 28v-31v: c. 26 long lines, ruled in ink, ruled space c. 165 c. 125

decoDesc.decoNote: Fols. 1r-27v: spaces left for 3-line initials, not filled in.

binding.p: Elaborate blind-tooled leather over wooden boards, with bosses and remains of two clasps, 'Great Yarmouth' on front and back cover; presumably made at Great Yarmouth, c. 1614, re-using earlier boards (?).

history.origin:
c. 1400 (fols. 1-27); 15th century, middle (?) (fols. 28-31); 1614 (fols. 32-72)
England, Norfolk, Great Yarmouth
history.provenance: Yarmouth, borough archives (cf. Tanner, Notitia Monastica)
Delivered by Thomas Royall on 15 Feb. 1710 from the town clerk's office of Great Yarmouth to Henry Borrett (mayor of Yarmouth in 1711) (back pastedown)
history.acquisition: Bequeathed by him to the Bodleian.
